_readme: Copy to safe-owners.json (gitignored) and fill in. Input to the three PM-D4
Send each candidate docs/SIGNER_BRIEF.md and the `message` below, verbatim.
They sign it with their wallet's 'Sign message' (EIP-191) — not a
transaction, no gas, cannot move anything — and send back only the address
NEVER put a private key or seed phrase in this file. The scripts refuse to
run if they find one, and rightly: a signer key that has been transmitted is
no longer a signer key. Nobody entitled to ask you for one will ask.
The message is signed by all three and includes the purpose and a date, so a
signature they produced for something else cannot be replayed into this role.
Change the date to the day you actually collect them.
message: I control this address and accept the role of Tosh Protocol Safe signer (2-of-3, Robinhood Chain 4663). Collected 2026-09-04.

signers.name: you (fresh hardware key — NOT the deployer EOA)
